headline: Australia Proposes Rules Allowing Super Funds to Invest in Startups and Energy
summary: Australian Treasurer Jim Chalmers proposed reforms to superannuation investment guidelines, enabling funds to allocate capital to higher-risk assets like startups, housing, and energy projects.
why: Australia's A$3.9 trillion superannuation sector is one of the largest pension asset pools in the world.

impacts.name: Australia
impacts.why: Rules governing Australia's pension funds are being updated to allow broader investment strategies.
